evals.prompt: ELI5 what a database index is
expectations: Treats the audience as a young child because none was named
Uses no technical jargon, or defines any term immediately
Uses one comparison from a child's world (books, toys, etc.)

evals.prompt: Explain to my manager why our nightly build keeps timing out (the test suite grew to 40 minutes and CI kills jobs at 30).
expectations: Leads with impact rather than mechanism
Gives options with rough cost or time
Ends with a recommendation or a decision needed

evals.prompt: Explain how a Bloom filter works to a senior backend engineer.
expectations: Uses correct terminology (hash functions, bit array, false positives)
Covers the trade-off: no false negatives, tunable false-positive rate, no deletion in the basic form

evals.prompt: How do I explain two-factor authentication to my dad?
expectations: Comparison drawn from something he already uses (a key plus a PIN, bank card, etc.)
Says why it matters to him personally

evals.prompt: Explain what an LLM context window is to my 10-year-old and to a product manager.
expectations: The child's version uses school or game comparisons and simple words
The PM's version frames it in terms of user impact and product limits

evals.prompt: ELI5 why the sky is blue
expectations: Simplifies without stating anything false (e.g. does not claim the sky reflects the ocean)

evals.prompt: Refactor this function to use async/await.
expectations: Skill should not trigger: no explanation or audience requested
